hooks.name: Keep the spec's task list honest
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to keep the spec's task checklist in step with verified work.

action.prompt: Before ending the turn: if this turn finished or changed work listed in .kiro/specs/live-ops/tasks.md, tick or untick the matching checkboxes so the file reflects what is actually built and verified. Only tick a task when it was verified (a test, an API call, or a screenshot), not merely written.
